enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain asleep. Shift position. Continue sleeping. Wake up at 06:45.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, washing up, and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Take off sleepwear. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Put toothbrush down. Wash face with water. Dry face with towel. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Turn off bathroom light. Turn off water heater. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, bread, and butter. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Take out frying pan. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Take out plate. Put eggs on plate. Take out bread. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait. Toast pops up. Take out toast. Put toast on plate. Spread butter on toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Eat toast. Drink milk. Finish meal. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and glass. Place in sink. Wipe table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing the day's schedule, checking emails, and planning illustration work at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 2. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Turn on monitor. Sit at desk. Open email client. Check emails. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Review schedule. Open planner. Write notes. Open illustration software. Create new file. Sketch thumbnails. Write notes for illustration work. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Continue planning.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on arts administration tasks: emails, grant reporting, and coordinating program logistics
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email. Compose emails. Send emails. Open grant reporting documents. Fill out forms. Write reports. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Pick up phone. Make phone calls. Coordinate program logistics. Send calendar invites. Update program documents. Take a break. Stand up. Stretch. Sit back down. Continue working.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Take out cutting board. Chop vegetables. Take out pan. Turn on induction cooker. Cook lunch. Turn off induction cooker. Take out plate. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in sink. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting and watching TV during a lunch break
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Browse phone. Put phone down. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on a freelance illustration commission at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 2. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Turn on monitor. Open illustration software. Open commission file. Sketch drawing. Draw lines. Apply colors. Use drawing tablet. Adjust brush settings. Save file. Take a break. Stand up. Stretch. Sit back down. Continue drawing. Add details. Save file again.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, making tea, and taking a short break
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Wait for kettle to boil. Kettle boils. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Steep tea. Remove tea bag. Add milk. Stir tea. Sit at table. Drink tea. Finish tea. Wash mug. Place mug in drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing illustration work and finishing remaining admin tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 2. Sit at desk. Open illustration software. Continue drawing. Save file. Close illustration software. Open email. Finish admin tasks. Reply to emails. Update grant report. Save documents. Close email. Shut down computer. Turn off monitor. Turn off desk lamp.

Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 1. Discuss dinner plan. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Member 1 turns on induction cooker. Member 2 turns on oven. Member 1 stirs pot. Member 2 checks oven. Member 2 says 'Can you pass me the salt?' Member 1 passes salt. Member 2 seasons dish. Turn on range hood. Continue cooking. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off oven. Turn off range hood.

Sit at table with Member 1. Serve food onto plates. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Chew food. Drink water. Talk with Member 1. Member 2 says 'This tastes good.' Member 1 replies 'Thanks.' Continue eating. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room with Member 1. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV with Member 1. Talk with Member 1. Member 2 says 'What do you want to watch?' Member 1 replies 'Let's watch this.' Continue watching. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher, and tidying the kitchen with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen with Member 1. Clear dishes from table. Scrape food into trash. Stack dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counters with cloth. Member 1 sweeps floor. Member 2 wipes stove. Put away leftover food. Close refrigerator. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living area and vacuuming
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up items from floor. Put cushions back on sofa. Fold blankets. Take out vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture to vacuum underneath. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Wrap cord. Put vacuum away. Turn off living room light.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal drawing and sketching practice at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 2. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Take out sketchbook. Take out pencils. Open sketchbook. Draw lines. Sketch shapes. Practice shading. Use eraser. Turn page. Sketch more. Take reference photo with phone. Put phone down. Continue sketching. Close sketchbook. Put pencils away. Turn off desk lamp.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Wet face with water. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Apply toner. Apply moisturizer. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Put toothbrush down. Turn off bathroom light. Turn off water heater. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading to wind down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 2. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Continue reading. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down on bed.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain asleep. Shift position. Continue sleeping.
